exam_scheme.note: Conducted by the Department of School Education, Government of Assam, in provision of Section 23 of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009, in strict conformity with National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) norms. The examination consists of two objective papers: Paper-I for Lower Primary (Classes I to V) and Paper-II for Upper Primary (Classes VI to VIII). Each paper comprises 150 multiple choice questions (MCQs) for 150 marks with a duration of 150 minutes (2 hours 30 minutes). There is no negative marking. Qualifying standard is 60% aggregate (90 out of 150 marks) and minimum 60% (18 out of 30 marks) in Language-I for General category candidates; a 5% aggregate relaxation to 55% (83 out of 150 marks) and 10% relaxation in Language-I to 50% (15 out of 30 marks) is granted to SC, ST(P), ST(H), OBC, MOBC, and PwD candidates. TET qualification certificates carry lifetime validity.
